# apple_analytics_report_request (Resource)

Requests the analytics reports of an app. An `ONGOING` request generates reports every day; a `ONE_TIME_SNAPSHOT` generates historical data once. The first reports take one to two days. App Store Connect stops a request whose reports nobody downloads for a long time; the resource then replaces it, because only a new request resumes the reports. Find the reports with `data.apple_analytics_reports`. Destroying the resource deletes the request. Import it with `<app_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_analytics_report_request" "ongoing" {
  app_id      = data.apple_app.example.id
  access_type = "ONGOING"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_type` (String) Kind of request: `ONGOING`, `ONE_TIME_SNAPSHOT`. Changing it creates a new request.
- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app. Changing it creates a new request.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the analytics report request.
- `stopped_due_to_inactivity` (Boolean) Whether App Store Connect stopped the request because its reports were not downloaded. A stopped request is replaced.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_analytics_report_request.ongoing
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
    id     = "2c4e6a8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the analytics report request.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_analytics_report_request.ongoing 1234567890/2c4e6a8b-0d1f-4b3a-9c5e-7f8a9b0c1d2e
```
